
---
applyTo: "**/*.{jsx,tsx,js,ts,vue,html,css,scss}"
---

# FRONTEND RULES

- Modify only the requested component.
- Reuse existing components and hooks.
- Follow the existing project architecture.
- Do not introduce new libraries without permission.
- Avoid unnecessary component restructuring.
- Do not modify global styles unless requested.
- Preserve existing naming conventions.
- Avoid changing unrelated components.
- Do not regenerate complete files when a small patch is enough.
- Check only directly related imports and dependencies.
